pairs.difference: A: the cap's board catches a clean pale top plane, and the drum below drops into a dark shadow side, so there is a clear step from light to shadow. Its shading range (0.847) is slightly above the real band, though the pale board may inflate it. B: the boot shaft and toe carry a broad, even warm sheen. The shadow side barely darkens, form contrast is lower, the shading stays warm throughout, and there is no cool core shadow down the back of the shaft.
pairs.fix: Light the boot from the upper left. Let the back of the shaft and heel fall into a clearly darker, cooler shadow with a soft core line, and keep the highlight only on the toe and front of the shaft.

pairs.difference: A: the silver star has pillowed facets that turn from bright centre to shaded edges, and the gold balls have compact highlights. B: the bracelet is matte and gently shaded, with a slow fade from the upper left to the lower right band. There is no defined core shadow on the inner wall, and the raised notes cast only faint shadows. Its form contrast (0.315) is just under the real floor.
pairs.fix: Make the inside of the band much darker where it turns away from the light. Give each raised note and speaker a small dark shadow on the band beside it.

pairs.difference: A: the jacket is shaded in warm olive-brown with a muddy, even turn across sleeves and body. The shadows stay warm and there is no cool side plane. In the lens the backdrop falls to near black around a glow behind the jacket. B: the hat has a clear lit crown, a cool gray-blue underside of the brim and a deep dent shadow, which matches the real glove and camera shading in the lessons.
pairs.fix: Light the jacket from one upper side. Turn the far sleeve and the side of the body into a cooler, darker shadow with a soft edge, and remove the glow behind the jacket.

pairs.difference: A: the ticket is almost unshaded. The face and panel are flat fills, the only form is a thin darker edge along the bottom, and a pale glow surrounds it in the lens. Its shading range (0.298) is far below the real floor of 0.500. B: the sign planks have a lit top face, a dark underside and thickness edge, and carved recesses that hold shadow, all from a consistent upper-left key.
pairs.fix: Draw the ticket as a thick card lit from the upper left. Give it a bright top edge, a clearly darker lower side edge, a soft gradient across the face and a soft shadow under the raised panel. Remove the glow around it.

pairs.difference: A: the cactus and pot are lit almost evenly from the front. The ribs read as repeated stripes, the pot's body barely darkens on the left, yet a long cast shadow runs left along the shelf. Form contrast (0.376) is below the real floor. B: the vending machine has a clear split between a dark left side plane and a lit front, with a soft floor shadow matching that direction.
pairs.fix: Darken the left side of the cactus and pot into a real shadow side that matches the shadow on the shelf, and make the light fade smoothly around the trunk instead of repeating on each rib.

pairs.difference: A: the ball has one sharp white hot spot at the upper right, but its body turns very gently. The panels hold their colour with no real core shadow, and the lens shows flat gray-brown with a lower shading range (0.533, below the real floor). B: the saddle has modelled leather with broad sheen on the seat, dark folds under the skirt and firm cast shadows on the fence rails, though its range (0.624) is also under the floor.
pairs.fix: Shade the ball as a sphere. Keep one soft highlight at the upper right, let all panels darken steadily toward the lower left into a clear shadow band, and darken the contact point on the sand.

pairs.difference: A: the rope coil and rail are lit from the left, with a soft dark cast shadow on the beam and shaded gaps between coils. B: the sneakers sit on a hard-edged, heavy blue-violet shadow, while their uppers stay evenly lit and glossy with no steady light-to-dark side. Light bias (0.019) is below the real floor and shading range (0.82) above the real ceiling.
pairs.fix: Soften and lighten the shoes' floor shadow, and keep it darkest only at the contact under the soles. Light the shoes from one upper side so the far side of each shoe falls into gentle shadow.

pairs.difference: A: the fountain tiers have clear lit top faces and darker undersides, and the bowls hold real shadow under the rims. B: the wagon's canvas turns very slowly, with soft shallow folds and no shadow side. In the lens the whole wagon is flat tan with only a soft cast shadow below, and shading range (0.576) is below the real floor.
pairs.fix: Light the canvas from the upper left. Let the right end and the folds fall into a darker, cooler shadow, deepen the shadow inside the hoop and under the wagon bed, and add dark contact where the wheels meet the ground.

pairs.difference: A: the kettle has a broad sheen on the body, a modelled dent, a darker right edge and a soft cast shadow to the right of the logs. B: the ice tray is softly lit on all its faces, the cups do not separate into light and shadow sides, and the cube edges blur. Only a faint cast falls on the table. Form contrast (0.378) is below the real floor.
pairs.fix: Give the tray one upper-left light. Make the top rim bright, the right-hand cup walls clearly darker, and add a defined soft shadow on the wood with a darker line where the cups touch it.

pairs.difference: A: the saloon has a lit facade, a darker side wall and a deep cast shadow under the porch roof and in the doorway. B: the dock posts have a lit orange face, a darker side and a soft shadow on the deck, with the rope and ring modelled normally. All measures sit within the real band and neither card shows a lighting tell.

A: the locomotive is shaded the same way everywhere, with a highlight on nearly every gold and red fitting and no dominant side, in a warm lens. Light bias (0.074) is below the real floor. B: the bus has a clear organization, with a lit top and side, a shaded front, cooler violet shadows and a long shadow across the road, which matches the real cards' cool shadow side.
pairs.fix: Light the train from the upper left only. Let the boiler and cab fall into a cool shadow toward one side, keep highlights to a few main curves, and add a darker cast shadow under the body onto the track.

pairs.difference: A: the ferris wheel's spokes and rim are evenly lit ivory with soft blurred edges, almost no shadow side and only faint overlap shadows. Light bias (0.037) is below the real floor, and it looks softer than the crisp wheel on the real sheet. B: the jellyfish's low range (0.416) comes from its dark water and glowing body, with a rim glow, tiny white sparkles and light shafts that fit a translucent subject.
pairs.fix: Light the wheel from the upper left. Give each spoke and the rim a bright side and a darker side, add small shadows where spokes cross, and keep edges crisp.

pattern: Generated cards tend to light the object evenly from the front, so light turns slowly and no side falls into a real shadow. Shadows stay warm and shallow instead of cool and deep, with no clear core shadow. Highlights are scattered on many small parts, and a soft glow often surrounds the object. Contact and cast shadows are also weak, or they disagree with the shading on the body.
